name: Data Analyst
responsibilities: Write SQL against production and warehouse tables to pull clean, correct datasets, not just whatever query returns first
Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports (Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) that stakeholders check without asking you to re-run anything
Support experimentation and A/B tests, then explain what moved a metric to marketing, product, or ops teams in plain language
skills: SQL fluency: joins, aggregations, and window functions against real, messy production data
Building a dashboard someone other than you can read, trust, and self-serve from
Choosing the right visualization tool for the audience (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or Excel)
Translating a request like 'why did signups drop' into a specific, checkable analysis

evidence.title: Data Analyst Intern
evidence.quote: developing dashboards and reports that monitor business health and campaign performance, analyzing customer journeys across digital and retail touchpoints, supporting experimentation and A/B testing

evidence.title: Data Analyst Intern
evidence.quote: support campaign performance analysis and reporting, partnering with Client Services and Engineering to analyze data, validate audiences, and deliver clear, actionable insights
